notes: Spent all money clearing tags early and never rebuilt; then ran into a rezzed IP Block about 20 times with 0-1 credits and no breaker, and later reran F2P-protected HQ over and over to see the same Psychographics.

Left R&D with no ice for three turns and gave up 3 points; after that it played a solid, steady iced-remote scoring game, with only small inefficiencies (Sensie overdraw and discards, Hard-Hitting News tags never punished).

At 6 points with a 5-card grip it declined Obokata Protocol in open Archives about 17 times over 5 turns, when stealing it would have won the game; it then clicked for credits up to 37 and never contested the remote where the Corp was advancing agendas.

Private Security Force was stolen because rezzing Hadrian's Wall against Account Siphon left no money for the remote's ice; the Archer rez that trashed two breakers and the steady remote scoring afterward were strong.

Good HQ pressure with Paperclip and sensible economy cards; small mistakes were an early 1-credit facecheck and an Indexing run into a known Tollbooth that it paid for and still could not get through.

Held several agendas in a thinly iced HQ for the whole game without installing them, and lost Hostile Takeover from HQ; then it used Consulting Visit into Audacity to trash its own HQ, putting three agendas into open Archives, which the Runner took next turn for the win.
Efficient: it set up breakers and economy, then went straight at the advanced remote and stole three agendas while clearing tags as needed; the only oddity was a Bank Job that it never used.

Installed Atman at 0 strength, then clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 65 credits, never installing or running in any meaningful way while the Corp scored out; its two runs were facechecks it had no way through.

Twice played Biotic Labor only to click for credits and draw, and kept agendas in an HQ protected by a single Wall of Static, losing two of them there; scoring later from a well-iced remote with Accelerated Beta Test was good.
A clean, fast game: it fast-advanced Hostile Takeover, then scored out of an iced remote; the passive opponent never tested it, so there is little to judge.

Spent the game at 0-4 credits and left R&D without ice for about 8 turns, so it was lucky the Runner's roughly 25 R&D accesses found no agendas; its remote scoring and the Quantum Predictive Model trap after the Turnpike tag were well done.

Kept running into the HQ ice that Blue Sun kept reinstalling, which was obviously Chiyashi, losing its hand each time; then, sitting at 6 points with an empty grip, it ran into fresh unrezzed R&D ice against a 54-credit Corp and was flatlined by Chiyashi.

Played Psychographics for nothing and spent turns 2-6 clicking for credits and discarding with no ice and no installs; it then put Project Beale behind a single Wraparound, and after that one was stolen it put a second Beale in the same server, which was stolen too.

Never ran the single-ice remote where the Corp advanced and scored three agendas over several turns; instead it ran open HQ four times a turn, re-seeing the same Reconstruction Contract, Dedication Ceremony and Wall to Wall, while stuck at 2-3 credits.
Good use of Temujin Contract on R&D and cheap HQ runs through Pop-up Window led to a fast win; its slow tag removal let the Corp trash resources, which was a minor oddity.

Clicked for credits up to 29 while R&D had no ice and played Dedication Ceremony twice on the Runner's cards to no effect; it then fed three agendas in a row into the same single-Border-Control remote that the Runner was already breaking, without ever adding ice.

Played Account Siphon twice into an already-rezzed Enigma it could not break, and wasted clicks for many turns in a loop of taking a tag from Joshua B. and paying to remove it; it also paid 9 for Femme Fatale and never ran HQ afterwards, but it won slowly on R&D pressure.

Used Send a Message's free Chiyashi rez to protect a quick Obokata score, and later used Divert Power cleverly to get Anansi up for free, setting up a Loki/Anansi flatline; economy was thin in the midgame.

Scored repeatedly behind IP Block against a Runner who could not break it, and used Exchange of Information well; but it left R&D without ice for six turns, which cost two agendas, and sat at 0-2 credits while Sensie overdraws forced big discards.

Went to 0 credits on turn 1 and never built economy, then kept spending clicks on open R&D runs while sitting on 3 or more tags against a tag-punishing Corp, and was flatlined by High-Profile Target; it also never pressured the advancing remotes.
